text:
maria: Quick thread to lock down an SI co-sell "handoff play" that covers marketplace leads, hardware partner intros, and who kicks off joint announcement prep. want something razor-simple we can pilot.

aj: tl;dr? what changes for AEs and partner PMs?

maria: Short version: 1) 48h claim window for SI on new leads that show SI-referral; 2) marketplace leads default to marketplace intake unless labeled SI-referral; 3) HW partner leads go to SI if SI introduced before PoC; otherwise AE owns.

kevin: Example scenario: SI runs workshop and leaves a lead in marketplace form. How does SFDC reflect that?

maria: SFDC rule example (pseudo):
```
if lead.source == "marketplace" and lead.referrer_type == "SI" then owner = SI_partner (claimable)
elif lead.source == "hardware_partner" and SI_intro_stage >= "PoC" then owner = SI_partner
else owner = Redwood_AE after 48h auto-claim
```

sylvie: For joint announcements: Redwood owns press release and blog framework. SI may co-author. PR must be submitted for legal/comms review min 5 business days prior. SI handles direct customer comms by default.

aj: SLA for SI to claim/engage? need concrete numbers.

maria: Proposal: SI must claim within 48 hours of intake or AE auto-claims. SI first-reply SLA = 5 business days for outreach cadence. If missed, AE outreach template triggers.

kevin: What about enterprise-tier exceptions? big deals should have a different flow.

maria: Governance rule: deals > $1M require signoff from AE leader + Partner Lead + RevOps before full ownership transfer. We'll add a checkbox on intake form for "high-value".

orch-bot: Notice: intake-rule v1.4 deployed to staging. Duplicate-checker active; watch for false-positives.

aj: operational question: where do partners record acceptance? SFDC + partner_claim tag?

maria: Yes. Use tag "si_claimed:<partner_name>" and a short SFDC note. revops to add validation rule to prevent empty partner_name when tag set.

revops: noted. I'll add validation and a dashboard alert for unclaimed marketplace leads older than 72h. ETA: next Wed.

kevin: Can we auto-build the partner-intro email with the marketplace listing link and a demo runbook attachment? cuts manual steps.

sylvie: I'll create canonical templates (intro, demo logistics, follow-up) and share edit rights with top 10 SI PMs.

maria: Action items: 
- kevin: SFDC tag + sample automation (due Fri)
- aj: update AE playbook w/ 48h rule + exception flow (due Tue)
- sylvie: publish templates + PR checklist (due Thu)
- revops: add validation rule + dashboard (due next Wed)

kevin: I'll also draft a short HW-demo runbook (lab access, AMI, P0 testcases).

aj: I'll loop in legal on joint-announce NDAs and create a one-pager for AEs to reference.

maria: Plan: ship this as a pilot for 2 weeks with Concert SI (gold tier) + one HW partner. we'll iterate after pilot metrics: claimed_rate, time_to_first_contact, duplicate_rate.

sylvie: small ask: can we include a "joint-demo kit" checklist so SIs know infra needs ahead of time?

maria: yes, include kit in templates. if no objections, i'll merge playbook and post in #partnerships tomorrow morning. :rocket:
